**Introduction to Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.**

Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a leading innovator in the chemical industry, specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of high-performance chemical materials. Headquartered at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China, the company has established itself as a trusted partner for global clients seeking advanced chemical solutions. With a strong commitment to technological innovation and sustainable development, Runhe Chemical has built a reputation for delivering high-quality products that meet the evolving demands of industries such as coatings, adhesives, construction, electronics, and automotive.

Founded on a foundation of scientific expertise and industrial excellence, the company integrates cutting-edge R&D with state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities to produce a diverse range of chemical materials, including polyurethane resins, waterborne coatings, and specialty additives. Runhe Chemical places a strong emphasis on environmental responsibility, adhering to strict quality control standards and eco-friendly production practices to minimize its ecological footprint.

Backed by a team of experienced professionals and a robust supply chain, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. continues to expand its market presence both domestically and internationally. By fostering long-term partnerships and prioritizing customer satisfaction, the company remains at the forefront of the chemical industry, driving progress through innovation and reliability. Whether serving industrial manufacturers or end-users, Runhe Chemical is dedicated to providing tailored solutions that enhance performance, efficiency, and sustainability.
